title: Enable or disable the physical eject button
summary: Control whether the physical eject button on your drive is ignored. Setting it to 'on' prevents the button from ejecting the drive.

steps.explain: Set whether the physical eject button is ignored. Use 'on' to prevent ejecting via the button, or 'off' to allow it.

placeholders.name: STATE
placeholders.description: Either 'on' (to ignore the button) or 'off' (to allow the button).
